corrections.was: A red staircase climbs as the player learns skills along a famous first level, World one-one. Level design is planning and building the spaces the player moves through. Teaching through levels means the first level lets the player try each skill, with no text. Here seven skills are taught with no tutorial words. For example, level design places the floor, spikes and goal flag of a Walker level, and it teaches by setting a small, harmless gap before the first deadly one.
